purpose: Change a product's visual system without replacing its product, content, workflows, data, or specialist layout.
preserve: specialist layouts that still serve the product
repairBeforeSwap: fixed panels that do not fit phones
proof: capture the same populated screens before and after
exercise every changed control with pointer and keyboard
check light and dark only when the selected kit owns both
check loading, empty, error, success, disabled, and recovery states
confirm there is no page-level overflow or hidden action
keep one reversible appearance switch and one clean rollback point

iconPolicy.primary: Lucide for everyday controls, navigation, and actions.
iconPolicy.secondary: Material Symbols Rounded when the broader object or concept is not available in Lucide.
iconPolicy.brands: Use verified brand marks only for companies and products; never substitute a general interface icon.
iconPolicy.custom: Create a new icon only when neither approved family communicates the concept and the mark is not a brand asset.

fontPolicy.selection: Choose only the families required by the product's reading, display, and technical roles.
fontPolicy.loading: Load only the chosen families and weights in the final product.
fontPolicy.proof: Test real headings, paragraphs, controls, tables, long labels, and phone layouts before approval.

rollback: The visual swap remains isolated from product behavior so the previous appearance can be restored without undoing product work.
